I implemented `Uint8Array.fromBase64` in `from_base64.rs`, and all 26 runs under `built-ins/Uint8Array/fromBase64/` pass. `cargo clippy` is clean and `cargo build` succeeds.

`setFromBase64` can call `from_base64_bytes`, the `FromBase64` implementation, which takes an optional `max_length`. It returns a `(read, bytes, error)` tuple rather than a struct, to avoid a dead-code lint on the unused `read` field, and there's no `#[allow]` anywhere in the file. The option helpers (`get_options_object`, `get_alphabet_option`, `get_last_chunk_handling_option`) and the `Alphabet` and `LastChunkHandling` enums are `pub(crate)` in this file too. `SkipAsciiWhitespace` and the two chunk-decoding helpers are private.
